_meta.description: Golden query set for NFR-3 (first-result accuracy). 50 baseline queries across 18 packs (CI gate for v1.0) + 18 adversarial queries (WS-A.1 baseline; normalized ranker wired in bfd5f76 — 12/18 adversarial pass pre-3.2, 6 fail on expected_first). Task 3.2 adds forbidden_top3 exclusion assertions to 7 adversarial queries; post-3.2 adversarial: 11/18 pass (systemctl-restart concern: forbidden id still in top-3). Authored 2026-06-21 (25 baseline) + 2026-06-24 (25 baseline) + 2026-06-29 (18 adversarial) + 2026-06-30 (3.2 de-tautologize).
_meta._comment: TODO(confidence-gate): gibberish queries (asdfqwer, zxqbzxqb blblblblb vvwwxxyz) return top-8 by source/popularity; expected_first pinned to deterministic top card (aws-cloudfront-create-invalidation) until a confidence-threshold gate lands (post-v1 backlog, arch doc §8).
_meta.rules: Per query: assert expected_first is at rank 1, and every id in acceptable_top3 is within the top 3. expected_first=null asserts the zero-result state renders (FR-S9). Adversarial queries (adversarial: true) have expected_first pinned to the TARGET behavior the 5.3 rewrite must produce; the current ranker's actual output is recorded in each query's _comment field. The default bench runs all 68 queries; --adversarial filters to the 18. Neither is gated by verify:all until Phase 6 wires the adversarial gate in.
_meta.scope: git (10) + docker (5) + kubectl (4) + gh (3) + curl (3) + aws-cli (2) + bash (2) + jq (2) + make (2) + nginx (2) + pnpm (2) + psql (2) + python (2) + ripgrep (2) + ssh (2) + systemctl (2) + terraform (1) + tmux (1) + zero-match (2) + adversarial (18).

task-5.1b owner decision 'plain command wins': bare `docker ps` (no compose intent) ranks plain docker-ps first. Base syntax scores are EQUAL (docker-ps and docker-compose-ps both exact-match at 100); the variant only led earlier via its +1 official-source bonus. The command-modifier penalty (-2 per uncovered command token, here `compose`) now overcomes that bonus so the plain card wins. Reverses the prior fixture, mirroring the docker-logs decision.

TARGET: git-reset-soft-head-1. Current ranker returns git-stash (tool token 'reset' is treated as low-signal and a high-frequency card wins). 5.3 rewrite must return git-reset-soft-head-1 — a reset query must rank a reset card first.

TARGET: git-reset-soft-head-1. Current ranker returns git-stash; query order is irrelevant to BM25 token overlap, so 'reset git' has the same wrong outcome as 'git reset'. 5.3 rewrite must return git-reset-soft-head-1 for both orderings.

TARGET: git-reset-soft-head-1. Current ranker returns git-reset-soft-head-1 first (already correct) but also surfaces git-stash in the top 3 even though no token matches. 5.3 rewrite must keep git-reset-soft-head-1 first AND drop unrelated git cards out of the top 3. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

TARGET: nginx-redirect. Current ranker returns jq-to-entries because the stopword 'to' inflates its score across the entire corpus. 5.3 rewrite must return nginx-redirect — stopwords must not be scored as command-field evidence. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

TARGET: kubectl-rollout-restart. Current ranker returns kubectl-logs because the typo 'roolout' blocks intent match. 5.3 rewrite must use fuzzy rescue and return kubectl-rollout-restart — fuzzy should help typo queries but stay behind exact/prefix/alias matches for the second token. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

RESOLVED (task-5.1b): docker-logs now ranks first. Base syntax scores tie at 105; docker-compose-logs previously edged ahead only on its +1 official-source bonus. The command-modifier penalty (-2 for the uncovered `compose` token) overcomes that bonus, so the plain exact-subcommand card wins when the query carries no compose intent.

TARGET: ssh-scp. Current ranker returns tmux-save-buffer because 'save' fuzzy-matches 'copy' and tmux wins on raw token score. 5.3 rewrite must return ssh-scp — alias 'copy file to server' must hit the ssh pack. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

TARGET: git-reset-soft-head-1. Current ranker passes by accident (no alias support yet). 5.3 rewrite must preserve this AND make it explicit via alias match — must add 'undo last commit' as an alias on git-reset-soft-head-1 so the result is robust to pack content changes.

TARGET: ssh-copy-id. Current ranker returns ssh-add because 'add' fuzzy-matches 'key' and ssh-add has higher popularity. 5.3 rewrite must return ssh-copy-id via alias — alias 'copy key to server' must outscore fuzzy matches.

TARGET: git-reset-hard-head. Current ranker returns make-all because 'all' is a high-frequency token in the make pack. 5.3 rewrite must return git-reset-hard-head via alias — stopword-like intent words must not bleed across packs. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

TARGET: nginx-redirect. Current ranker returns jq-to-entries because 'to' is scored as a real token. 5.3 rewrite must return nginx-redirect via alias 'http to https' — stopwords must be removed from intent scoring.
TARGET: curl-follow-redirects. Current ranker passes (curl-follow-redirects ranks first). 5.3 rewrite must preserve this and confirm it via alias match (no pack_id change needed).
TARGET: ssh-scp. Current ranker returns tmux-save-buffer; 'save' fuzzy-matches 'copy'. 5.3 rewrite must return ssh-scp via alias — copy-as-action intent must hit the ssh pack.
TARGET: psql-list-databases. Current ranker passes — psql-list-databases ranks first. 5.3 rewrite must preserve this.
TARGET: jq-select. Current ranker returns jq-exit-status because of -e/-n option fuzzy matches. 5.3 rewrite must return jq-select — 'filter' as intent should match the syntax field, not option flags.

TARGET: tmux-split-window. Current ranker returns tmux-rename-window above tmux-split-window despite all 3 tokens matching the second card. 5.3 rewrite must return tmux-split-window — within-pack ordering must respect full token coverage. forbidden_top3 added by task-3.2 to enforce the exclusion.

RESOLVED (task-5.1b owner decision): systemctl-restart is the decisive #1 (exact match on the dominant verb). The prior forbidden_top3:[systemctl-try-restart] was removed — try-restart and reload-or-restart are symmetric, equally-legitimate restart variants (each carries exactly one uncovered command token, so the command-modifier penalty hits both equally and cannot separate them). Excluding one but accepting the other was arbitrary; restart already wins rank 1, which is what matters.

TARGET: ssh-copy-id. Current ranker returns ssh-add (lowest-ID ssh-* card with 'key' in syntax). 5.3 rewrite must rank an authentication card (ssh-copy-id or ssh-keygen-ed25519) first — ambiguous intent must not default to first-by-id.
